# The terminal and an HPC cluster

This chapter introduces prompts, commands, login versus compute nodes, software
modules, storage locations and job schedulers. It explains why heavy analyses
should not be run on a shared login node and why `module purge` changes the
cluster-provided software layer without deactivating a Conda environment.

::: {.callout-note title="Coming in the guided build"}
The complete lesson will use annotated DLDCC examples while clearly marking
which paths, module names, accounts and partitions are site-specific.
:::
